answer: Because each jetty escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the walnut ledger records every share and the hollow audit publishes the split. A bond must be split across 4 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Assembling that for 84 aliases means 84 times 4 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
